members.description:
Requests a measurement of the intrinsic sizes for the next animation frame, coalesced with any other trigger, for
a change the element cannot see: content a slotted element renders in its own shadow root, an attribute-only
change, or an image or a font loading. In that frame it also re-chooses the tier from a fresh measurement of the
element's border box, as after a percentage inline padding that changes with the host's container. On an element
that is not in a document, never connected or removed, it does nothing. On an element that is not rendered (in a
closed `<dialog>`, under a `display: none` ancestor or `hidden`) the pass writes nothing and the tier stays; the
element measures itself afresh once it is rendered.

declarations.description:
A tooltip: a short text in a bubble beside its trigger, shown while the pointer rests on the trigger or the bubble
or the trigger has keyboard focus, hidden by Escape. The trigger carries its own accessible name; the bubble only
repeats or supplements it.

members.description: The bubble's plain text, never parsed as markup. An empty text shows no bubble.
members.name: text

members.description:
The side of the trigger the bubble is shown on: `top`, `bottom`, `start` or `end`, the last two in the tooltip's
direction; it is shown on the opposite side when it does not fit. Reflected.

The name of the board's region while it overflows, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without
one an overflowing board is a tab stop with no role. Not reflected.

declarations.description:
A row of lanes that scrolls inside itself, and is a tab stop and a named region, only while the lanes' minimum
widths exceed its size.

declarations.name: OcelleWorkflowBoard

slots.description: The lanes; any child is laid out as a lane.

attributes.description:
The lane's title, shown and used as its name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as absent, and no title is
shown. Not reflected.
attributes.name: label

attributes.description:
The count shown after the title with tabular figures, and named after it: a whole number of 0 or more. The
attribute counts when, after trimming, it is decimal digits alone, at most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; the
property when it is a safe integer of 0 or more; anything else counts as absent. Not reflected.
attributes.name: count

attributes.description:
The count's text in the lane's name, such as "3 work packages", trimmed; the visible count still shows the
number. Used only while a count is shown. Not reflected.
attributes.name: count-label

attributes.description:
`flat` drops the lane's ground, corners and padding and sets the title and count in small uppercase; absent or any
other value draws the default lane chrome. Reflected.
attributes.name: variant
